title: Release item
description: One release item note in the configured paths.releaseItems folder. Choices come from configs/collections/release-item.json; included and shipped are set by release candidates (node bin/app candidate), and the collection engine validates the result before a reviewed plan is shown.

fields.label: Summary: what changes for users (one line; details go in the note body)
Sources (comma-separated project paths such as prototypes/<slug>, docs/design/<prototype>, brainstorms/<slug>/feature.definition.json or a PRD, or RISK-/LRN- ids; optional)
Acceptance criteria (separated by ;, required once ready)
Risk ids (comma-separated, such as RISK-0001; optional)
Notes (optional, written to the note body)
